description: The Desalination Pulse: High-fidelity supply dynamics and dependency dashboard (2012-2024).
methodology: Data Harmonization: Performed a many-to-one join between the Greater Melbourne Potable Demand dataset and Desalination Order records. Engineered Field: Manually calculated 'Total Demand' by summing Residential, Non-Residential, and Non-Revenue categories to create a high-fidelity grey 'Silhouette' baseline. Narrative Sync: Strictly capped the X-axis at 2024 to match verified desal delivery data, avoiding speculative gaps for 2025 while maintaining the 2012-2024 'Pulse' story.
citation: Melbourne Water. (2026). Greater Melbourne Potable Demand & Desalination Orders. Spatially and temporally harmonized by D. Sharma (2026).
